question: Should OpenClaw adopt this process-wide localization registry, OPENCLAW_LOCALE behavior, and mandatory coverage-manifest gate as a core release contract?
rationale: The change creates a durable cross-product locale and CI governance surface; correctness tests alone cannot decide whether that policy and operator contract belong in core.

options.title: Sponsor a phased core rollout
options.body: Approve the shared locale contract and land narrowly ordered, rebased slices with compatibility and real-behavior proof.

options.title: Keep localization owner-local
options.body: Decline the process-wide registry and retain surface-specific localization without a mandatory global coverage gate.

options.title: Request a reduced proposal
options.body: Keep the contributor guide and inventory concept, but defer the environment variable and required CI gate until owners agree on the public contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a phased core rollout
recommendation.body: Approve the shared locale contract and land narrowly ordered, rebased slices with compatibility and real-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The author owns the linked proposal and cumulative implementation, though final product sponsorship must come from an OpenClaw code owner.
